title: env.boot.trace request
description: Boot a floppy in a seeded Amiga — exec and trackdisk serviced, the custom-chip range modelled — and report what it did, writing nothing. `read_only`. The environment is fixed because a boot block is written against *the* machine, not against one a caller describes.

maximum_steps.description: Instructions to execute before stopping. Clamped to what the executing context allows — 200000 by default, and at most 50000000 for a host running local media it has reviewed. Sandbox code is unknown code, and a request for an unbounded run would be asking the process to hang, so the budget is always finite. A reduction is reported as LIMIT_REDUCED.

watch.description: Absolute ranges whose accesses are attached to trace rows. At most 64: every watched range is compared against every memory access, so the list is a per-access cost rather than a per-request one. An excess is refused rather than truncated, because a dropped watchpoint would make a run that observed nothing indistinguishable from one that had nothing to observe.

stop_on_watch.description: Stop at the first instruction that touches a watched range.
